title: Avandar: save a dashboard view
description: Carry the existing district chart into a named dashboard, inspect the real Puck editor, and finish on the unpublished preview.
sourceNotes: Programmatic React rendering of actual components and styles from the enclosing Avandar worktree. Each build records the current source revision and SHA-256 hashes in ignored src/avandar/generated/build.json. Tracked sample MP4s retain their original export provenance.

These shots use the avandar scene and frame-controlled adapters in avandar-adapter/. They contain no screenshots, screen recordings, screenshot callouts, or prerecorded UI. The original generic demo and showcase remain separate.

All Harborfield records and locations come from the deterministic fictional bundle in demo-data/manifest.json, bound through avandar-adapter/fixtures.json. Fictional demonstration data remains visible. No real person, organization, or reporting area is represented.

Typing, selection, query results, save responses, and navigation are deterministic fixture states. Rendering invokes no product backend, authentication, persistence mutation, or publication operation. Source reuse establishes UI provenance, not a new end-to-end product test.

Historical browser evidence remains separate: accepted local rehearsal pilot-2026-10-14T22-11-57-800Z-Z53br8 passed import, explorer, dashboards, cases, and point-map checks with 14 checkpoints and zero blocked requests. Earlier capture results do not prove that this component film executed those operations.

Narration cues are authored against adapter frames. This source plan contains text cues and captions only; any generated voice is scratch narration and requires separate listening and timing review. Final render and frame-gate evidence are recorded after completed runs.

The actual SaveToDashboardCreateMode, Puck editor, useDashboardPuckConfig, DataVizContent, SaveDashboardButton, ViewDashboardButton and DashboardPreviewBanner are reused. The original full editor catalog, page fields and root renderer are preserved.

DataViz client/query ownership and unused field controllers are replaced by a fixture config. No Filter block is rendered. The native Puck iframe is disabled so the deterministic document renders text at its native size; source editor CSS remains in use.

The district chart retains exact fixture totals and ordering. Frame-based clip masks reveal its bar geometry without altering data or axis domains. The preview retains Not yet published. Viewers will not see this. No sharing, publication or access-control behavior is demonstrated.

Historical create-and-save succeeded in pilot-2026-10-14T21-53-32-840Z-XzCTmY; the accepted repeat capture reused the saved dashboard. This new film represents the same supported authoring flow with fixture state and performs no persistence operation.

shots.note: One continuous adapter timeline. All interaction, typing, chart and camera timing is body-local in the feature adapter.
